name: remoto
description: Acesso remoto próprio: agente Windows + sinalização WebRTC + cliente web

scripts.build: npm run build -w web-client && npm run build -w signaling
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w signaling
scripts.dev: npm run build -w web-client && npm run dev -w signaling
scripts.test: npm test -w protocol && npm test -w signaling && npm test -w web-client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p protocol && tsc -p signaling && tsc -p web-client
